_note: Token-aligned counterfactual lines for the CDIM experiment (Mechanistic_paper.md §3). Each entry replaces one bullet line of the named substrate file with a line that has the SAME token count under the Llama-3 and Qwen3 tokenizers and neutralises or reverses the line's semantics; cdim.py refuses a counterfactual whose token count differs, and keys entries by the file's basename. 'substrate.txt' = the nine-line substrate in prompts/ since 19 Sep 2026. 'L0.txt' / 'pro.txt' = the retired six-line abstract substrate and substrate_pro of 17 Sep (kept as cdim_sweep/ladder/L0.txt and pro.txt; the first-round results under results/<model>/bf16[-pro]/ were measured on those). Templated counterfactuals for the ladder levels L1-L5 live in cdim_sweep/ladder_counterfactuals.json. prompts/ itself is never modified.

substrate.txt.name: cf1
substrate.txt.text: - Perform an activity on an object at the starting location.

substrate.txt.name: cf2
substrate.txt.text: - All other objectives or goals are relevant for the user.

substrate.txt.name: cf3
substrate.txt.text: - The object is initially away from the user at another location.

substrate.txt.name: cf4
substrate.txt.text: - The activity is performed at the starting location.

substrate.txt.name: cf5
substrate.txt.text: - The object need not reach the service location for the activity performance.

substrate.txt.name: cf8
substrate.txt.text: - Walking does fully transport a vehicle.

substrate.txt.name: cf9
substrate.txt.text: - To transport a vehicle from one location to another, the user may leave it.

substrate.txt.name: cf9s
substrate.txt.text: - To transport a vehicle from one location to another, the user must leave it.

L0.txt.name: cf1
L0.txt.text: - Perform an activity on an object, without transporting the object from location A to B.

L0.txt.name: cf2
L0.txt.text: - All other objectives or goals are relevant for the user.

L0.txt.name: cf3
L0.txt.text: - Activities require the object to stay at location A while the user moves to location B.

L0.txt.name: cf4
L0.txt.text: - The object is never initially with the user at location A.

L0.txt.name: cf5
L0.txt.text: - Moving the user without moving the object does fully satisfy the objective.

L0.txt.name: cf6
L0.txt.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user may leave the object in order to perform the activity at location B.

L0.txt.name: cf6n
L0.txt.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user must inspect the object in order to perform the activity at location B.

L0.txt.name: cf6s
L0.txt.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user must leave the object in order to perform the activity at location B.

pro.txt.name: p1
pro.txt.text: - Perform an activity on an object at a starting location.

pro.txt.name: p2
pro.txt.text: - The object must be at the starting location for the activity to complete.

pro.txt.name: p3
pro.txt.text: - All other objectives or goals are relevant for the user.

pro.txt.name: p4
pro.txt.text: - The object is initially with the user at location B.

pro.txt.name: p5
pro.txt.text: - The activity is performed at location B (the service location). The object may be absent at location B.

pro.txt.name: p6
pro.txt.text: - Vehicles are fully portable. Walking brings a vehicle along. Leaving the object behind fails the objective.

pro.txt.name: p7
pro.txt.text: - Books are portable. Driving transports both the user and the book.

pro.txt.name: p8
pro.txt.text: - Leaving the object behind meets the objective.

pro.txt.name: p9
pro.txt.text: - To transport a vehicle from A to B, the user may leave it.

pro.txt.name: p9s
pro.txt.text: - To transport a vehicle from A to B, the user must leave it.
